Anchor.title: Anchor
Anchor.description: Where spoken text lives in the source. One of the three shapes in 04 (`playback.word`).

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: PDF points, origin top-left of the page (y grows downward).

RuleHit.title: RuleHit
RuleHit.description: Which rule changed what. Powers Script view, the speech diff and "why didn't it read that?".

SayRequest.title: SayRequest
SayRequest.description: Speak a short prompt in the assistant voice (onboarding, spoken hints). Returns when it has played.

TextSegment.title: TextSegment
TextSegment.description:
Spoken text [spoken_start, spoken_end) came from block text [src_start, src_end).

A lexicon replacement ("SQL" → "sequel") is one segment whose spoken and source ranges differ in
length. Text that has no source (a generated transform) has no segments; its utterance carries
block/section anchors instead.

WordBox.title: WordBox
WordBox.description: Word-level geometry for PDF highlight overlays: char range into Block.text + bbox.
